{{recipe}}

This a very easy and tasty [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]] sauce. It's good with just pasta, and goes well with a lot of vegetables as well. The quantities of ingredients vary with the amount of pasta, and with your taste preferences.

== Ingredients ==
*[[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Garlic|Garlic]] cloves
*Ripe [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*Ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*Fresh [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
*[[Cookbook:Oregano|Oregano]]
*Additional ingredients, as desired

== Procedure ==
#Finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chop]] tomatoes or [[Cookbook:Purée|purée]] them in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]]—this depends on what consistency you want. Chopping gives a chunkier sauce while using puréed tomatoes yields a smoother sauce.
#Grind garlic to paste.
#Heat oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]]. Using a pan with [[Cookbook:Non-stick|non-stick]] coating necessitates less oil.
#When oil is hot (but not too hot), turn down heat and add garlic paste.
#When garlic is golden-brown, add tomatoes.
#Tomatoes have to be cooked until done—they'll look and smell cooked instead of raw, and will be a deeper, redder colour.
#Add salt and pepper to taste.
#When tomatoes are almost done, add fresh cream to taste. Cook for about 30 seconds. 
#Add oregano, then cook for another minute.
#Add [[Cookbook:Boiled Pasta|cooked pasta]] and vegetables.
#Serve hot, garnished with herbs (e.g. [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]], [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]).
